overridesReason.@ledgerhq/devices: 8.17.0 dropped the hid-framing subpath that @ledgerhq/hw-transport-webusb@6.29.4 still imports, which fails the UI build. Reached via @creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit; drop this pin when that moves to v2.
overridesReason.rpc-websockets: 9.3.9 switched to uuid@14, which is ESM-only and cannot be required by the CommonJS server under jest. rpc-websockets only calls uuid.v1(), which uuid@11 provides. Drop this pin when abroad-server moves to ESM.
